title: Disappearing Act: How to Escape the Office
coreMove: Sell remote work as a controlled trial with clear output, reachability, and rollback terms; personal freedom follows when employer risk falls.

exampleSpecs.audience: an analyst asking for remote work
exampleSpecs.stakes: A broad request may sound like disappearing unless the manager sees proof and limits.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a remote-work proposal with trial period and manager rollback terms.

exampleSpecs.audience: a project lead comparing work sites
exampleSpecs.stakes: The office may be treated as productive even when meetings break the work apart.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use a remote day and productivity comparison against office interruptions.

exampleSpecs.audience: a support lead handling escalation coverage
exampleSpecs.stakes: A remote request can fail if the manager imagines unanswered messages.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Make communication rules explicit before the manager raises reachability fears.

exampleSpecs.audience: an editor seeking a flexible schedule
exampleSpecs.stakes: Asking too soon can make remote work look like a cover for weak delivery.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show strong performance coming before leverage.

exampleSpecs.audience: a controller negotiating one admin day away
exampleSpecs.stakes: A manager may reject the plan if approval feels permanent.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use reversibility to make approval safer.

exampleSpecs.audience: a coordinator seeking more location control
exampleSpecs.stakes: Winning the whole arrangement at once may trigger resistance.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show one successful trial creating the basis for more.
